description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Contexture seeks a Junior Software Developer to develop and modify Health Information Exchange interfaces and build HIE tools. The role supports new and existing solutions, including deployments, changes, and major incident response as applicable.
Junior Software Developer building and maintaining secure software solutions, integrations, and custom tools with technical documentation

Responsibilities:
• Write and maintain software for Contexture’s current and future tools and solutions
• Attend intermittent design discussions for new products, features, and tools
• Work with their Development Manager and other team members to follow best practices for integrations and custom tools. This position will be encouraged to think and provide feedback and suggestions for development efforts
• Work closely with Operations, QA (Quality Assurance), Implementation, and Project Management to support technical efforts throughout the SSDLC (Secure Software Development Life Cycle)
• Create, update, and maintain documentation of coded solutions
• Versatility and adaptability to evolving priorities in projects, products, and tasks
• Develop software utilizing security best practices
• Performs other related duties as assigned

Requirements:
• Understanding of Object-Oriented software development using languages such as C++, C#, or Python
• Knowledge of Object Notation Languages such as JSON, XML, BSON
• Good analytical and troubleshooting skills
• Knowledge of relational databases or NoSQL solutions, such as MongoDB
• Advanced written and verbal communication skills
• Must be able to clearly communicate technical information to non-technical business users and customers
• High School Diploma or equivalent (GED) required

Preferred:
• Knowledge of JavaScript frameworks such as Vue.js or jQuery
• Understanding of RESTful APIs
• Understanding of Git Version Control (GitHub)
• Knowledge of software development methodologies such as Waterfall and Agile
• Enjoys a collaborative environment and working as part of a team
• Associates/Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Information Systems, or another related field, and/or technical program certificate preferred
